product_overview: RentEase is a responsive property rental web platform that helps tenants discover and reserve homes and helps landlords manage listings, bookings, and tenant communication. It provides a streamlined rental experience with role-based access for tenants, landlords, and admins.
core_goals: Simplify property rental management for tenants and landlords
Enable secure communication between landlords and tenants
Streamline booking and rental payment workflows
Provide real-time updates and notifications for rental activity
Support transparency through admin oversight and moderation

features.name: Authentication and onboarding
features.description: Users can create an account and sign in to access the rental platform with role-based access.
user_flows: Navigate to /landing -> Enter phone number -> Request an OTP -> Enter the OTP code -> Provide username and password -> Complete registration and sign in
Navigate to /landing -> Enter phone number -> Request an OTP -> Enter the OTP code -> Sign in to the account

features.name: Messaging dashboard
features.description: Authenticated users can view conversations and exchange messages with other users.
user_flows: Navigate to /chat -> Select a conversation -> Type a message -> Send the message -> See the new message appear in the chat thread

features.name: Property discovery and search
features.description: Tenants can browse available properties, search by location, and narrow results using filters and sorting options.
user_flows: Navigate to the property search experience -> Search for a location -> Apply filters for price, property type, bedrooms, amenities, or availability -> Sort the results -> Review matching property listings
Navigate to the property search experience -> Search for a location -> Switch between grid and list views -> Open a property to review its details

features.name: Property listings management
features.description: Landlords can create, update, and remove property listings with details such as price, location, amenities, and images.
user_flows: Navigate to the property management experience -> Start a new property listing -> Enter the property title, description, address, city, price, type, bedrooms, bathrooms, and amenities -> Add property images -> Save the listing
Navigate to the property management experience -> Open an existing listing -> Update property details or images -> Save the changes
Navigate to the property management experience -> Open an existing listing -> Remove the listing from the platform

features.name: Booking management
features.description: Tenants can reserve properties and landlords can review booking requests, calendar availability, and booking history.
user_flows: Navigate to the booking experience -> Select available dates -> Submit a booking request -> See the booking marked as pending
Navigate to the booking management experience -> Review a pending booking request -> Approve or reject the request -> See the booking status update
Navigate to the booking dashboard -> Review past bookings -> Check booking status history

features.name: Payments
features.description: Users can make rental or deposit payments and review payment history and invoices.
user_flows: Navigate to the payment experience -> Choose a rent or deposit payment -> Enter payment details -> Submit the payment -> See the payment confirmation and invoice
Navigate to the payment history experience -> Review previous payments and transaction records

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Users receive updates about booking outcomes, messages, payments, and property changes.
user_flows: Receive a booking update notification -> Open the relevant booking or property context -> Review the update details
Receive a new message notification -> Navigate to the conversation -> Read the message thread

features.name: Admin dashboard
features.description: Admins can oversee users, listings, bookings, payments, reports, and platform analytics.
user_flows: Navigate to the admin dashboard -> Review platform metrics such as users, listings, bookings, and revenue -> Open management sections for users, listings, bookings, or reports -> Take moderation or oversight actions
Navigate to the admin analytics area -> Review performance charts and summaries -> Export or generate reports
